transitions.only_major_change: A compact suspended-sediment plume exits the mouth and slows in the nearby sea; no land emerges.
transitions.must_remain_fixed: orthographic camera, original coast, upstream river, sand texture, lighting and color palette
transitions.forbidden: camera motion, shoreline drift, dry land, bifurcation, offshore wide plume

first.meaning: 泥沙进入海水后减速并形成紧凑浑浊羽流

last.meaning: 河口外水下沉积明显累积，但仍被连续水体覆盖

transitions.only_major_change: The submerged deposit thickens and expands beneath continuous water; no dry land emerges.
transitions.must_remain_fixed: orthographic camera, original coast, upstream river, sand texture, lighting and color palette
transitions.forbidden: camera motion, shoreline drift, exposed sand, island shadow

first.meaning: 河口外水下沉积明显累积，但仍被连续水体覆盖

last.meaning: 同一浅滩的两个相邻湿沙斑块刚刚露出水面

transitions.only_major_change: Two adjacent wet sand patches belonging to one shoal break the water surface; no mature delta forms.
transitions.must_remain_fixed: orthographic camera, original coast, upstream river, sand texture, lighting and color palette
transitions.forbidden: camera motion, mature delta, many islands, complex channel network

first.meaning: 同一浅滩的两个相邻湿沙斑块刚刚露出水面

last.meaning: 同一沙洲继续存在，水流稳定地从两侧绕行

transitions.only_major_change: The two wet patches connect into one sandbar and the flow separates into exactly two paths around it.
transitions.must_remain_fixed: orthographic camera, original coast, upstream river, sand texture, lighting and color palette
transitions.forbidden: camera motion, extra islands, three or more channels, mature distributary tree
